task.title: HealthKit Sleep v2 historical Evidence and prospective preparation

result.summary: sleep-canon-v2 133d838e is live and healthy; its exact 2,878-sample zero-write validation passes with 11/11 corrected duplicate-copy nights and zero strategic leakage. Production PhysiqueOS coverage establishes 2026-07-06 as the historical product boundary. A structurally quarantined historical import and bounded Recovery/Sleep read model are implemented and tested; Native Build 74 is uploaded and VALID. Import count remains zero and first representable Sleep day remains an on-device result. Hardened Server commit b81c784e cannot be pushed/deployed until the exact private-source GitHub push is explicitly approved. D0 2026-10-07 is prepared in validation_only mode but not activated; strategic Sleep is OFF.

tests.summary: Sleep Server 120/120; phase-3 308/309 with one unrelated missing private fixture; Next build; iOS build; historical import and surrounding Native Sleep suites; Build 74 release/archive/upload guards.

review.summary: Adversarial review fixed exact instant fencing, historical command body bounds, result contract version, and stage-status projection before release preparation.

zero_write_audit.summary: Exact production runtime, 2,878 validation samples, 30 nights, 11/11 affected nights selected/conflict-free/tolerance-correct, prospective OFF, ordinary Sleep 0/0, strategic leaks 0, mutations 0.

decisions_required: Explicitly approve pushing Native commits cf00c234 and b6d98889 plus Server commit b81c784e to the dustinginn/physiqueos GitHub repository.
blockers: The private-source GitHub push safety gate blocks the hardened Server and integrated Native code pushes without exact explicit approval; therefore the Server slice cannot yet be deployed and the historical import cannot run.
The first representable Sleep day on or after 2026-07-06 requires Founder installation and operation of Build 74 after the Server slice is live.
unexpected_findings: The week beginning 2026-06-29 still has only three core-daily PhysiqueOS evidence days despite earlier Weight/canonical records; July 6 is the first consistently populated cross-domain boundary.
The reviewed read model initially inferred stage availability from numeric values rather than canonical completeness; adversarial testing caught and corrected this before deployment.
backlog: Push/deploy hardened Server slice after explicit approval.
Founder installs Build 74 and runs bounded historical Sleep Evidence import; record first representable day and sanitized counts/shape.
Run fresh D0 dry run and, only if all gates pass, activate October 7 prospective validation_only Sleep.
Design and Founder-approve Recovery Briefing card before any separate future strategic-graduation decision.
recommended_next_step: Approve the exact private-source GitHub pushes listed in decisions_required; then deploy b81c784e, install Build 74, run the bounded historical import, and reevaluate the still-future October 7 D0 without enabling strategic Sleep.
